github.description: AX-first computer use for AI agents on macOS with optional Jev (TypeSafe System One) semantic guards: calibrated target/input judgments before an irreversible action, decisions kept in code. Accessibility-tree targeting, window-scoped input, clipboard-safe paste, read-back verification. Ships a pip CLI, a pi package and a DeepSeek Harness plugin.

readme.excerpt: AX-first macOS computer use for AI agents: an MCP server and a CLI. Agents read the accessibility tree instead of guessing coordinates from screenshots. Input is posted to the target app in the background, so your cursor never moves, and every action is verified.
